overview_description.description:
Lalabox is a mobile application that offers live-streaming and shopping services.

It offers an online platform that allows users to watch, stream, and share videos, while buying and selling various products.

Lalabox was founded in 2020 by Kirill Avery and Yurii Yatsenko.
